description: Can this wallet move USDC or USDT? Live check of issuers' own on-chain blacklists: Circle USDC (Base, Ethereum, Arbitrum, Optimism, Polygon, Avalanche), EURC (Base, Ethereum), Tether USDT (Ethereum, Tron), plus OFAC SDN exact match. Up to 20 EVM 0x or Tron T addresses. Returns PASS/BLOCK, which token+chain is frozen, block numbers, contracts read. Fails closed: chain unreadable = 502, not charged. 400 invalid address. PAID: $0.001 USDC per call on Base via x402 (MCP transport: retry with params._meta["x402/payment"]). Same tool over plain HTTP: GET /v1/wallet/stablecoin-blacklist.

address.description: one EVM 0x or Tron T address, or up to 20 comma-separated (mixed allowed)

name: stablecoin_blacklist_check
title: Stablecoin freeze check (Circle USDC/EURC, Tether USDT incl. Tron) + OFAC
